title: On an Italian dock, the EU’s new asylum pact gives rescued migrants a rushed ‘tick-box’ border screening
lede: The impact of the EU's new pact on migration and asylum is clearly visible from an Italian port quay on the day of a migrant disembarkation. First touching land after having survived a sail aboard an overcrowded dinghy in a storm, 28 migrants were trooped through a sped-up "box-ticking" screening, which experts worry will not accurately measure the vulnerabilities they're up against.
